model_summary.model: Poisson log-linear rate trend with population offset

backtest.interpretation: Internal temporal validation with 5 expanding-window one-step-ahead folds.

assumptions.estimand: Expected 2023 counterfactual cancer deaths on the Gaza pre-war registration scale
assumptions.not_estimand: True total cancer deaths or observed 2023 registered deaths
assumptions.primary_baseline_uncertainty: Joint MVN sampling of alpha and beta using Pearson-scaled Poisson covariance; no additional Poisson process count was drawn.
assumptions.hr_uncertainty: Normal sampling on log-HR scale; SE recovered from reported 95% CI.
assumptions.factor_combination: Factors are evaluated one at a time and are not multiplied or summed into a joint effect.
assumptions.structural_baseline_sensitivity: All coefficient vectors sampled from multivariate normal approximations; alternative OLS models use residual-variance covariance.
assumptions.particulate_analysis_role: Exploratory: the primary concentration increment is based on October 2023 only and does not observe November or December variation.
assumptions.communication_primary_definition: low=Very poor (66/658); main=Very poor+Poor (197/658); high=Good+Poor+Very poor, excluding Excellent and Fair (361/658)
assumptions.communication_legacy_definition_sensitiv: 197/658, 395/658, and 559/658 retained only as definition sensitivity because Fair is included in the latter two legacy categories.
